thread:
alex: BluePraxis (BPX-442) ping 3/13-3/15 billing: onboarding promo 'bulk-onboard-weekend' didn't apply for weekend traffic. They sent invoice INV-2026-03-20, claiming $500 should have been discounted.

marta: Can you paste the invoice line and the customer's expected promo calculation?

alex: Invoice INV-2026-03-20 line: bulk_ingest_ingress: 20,000 units @ $0.04 = $800. Promo is 40% for weekend onboarding -> $320 expected discount. Customer says they received $0.

sam: I checked billing events. We shift the billing window at 00:00 UTC but onboarding promo is tagged in customer local TZ; weekend promo logic excluded records falling in the boundary when DST flagged the account as 'America/Los_Angeles' vs 'UTC'. Snippet: ```
2026-03-14T00:00:02Z INFO billing-window: record 0x9f shift tz mismatch for BPX-442
```

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-4620 to track BluePraxis timezone promo miss, linked to INV-2026-03-20.

marta: Policy: system-caused promo misses get retro credits. Propose amount?

alex: Based on expected discount $320, recommend issuing promo credit $320. Customer is small-revenue but active; maybe add $30 goodwill. Total $350.

kevin: Heads up, if we add goodwill must use SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026 GL and note reason for audit. I'm ok approving up to $400 for quick remediation.

marta: Approval noted. Ledger note: "Time-zone boundary caused weekend onboarding promo to miss for 3/13-3/15. Promo credit $320 + goodwill $30. Approved by finance lead kevin." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

kevin: Approved. Please create credit memo (apply to invoice rather than refund).

alex: Creating CM-2026-042 for $350 and applying to INV-2026-03-20. Attaching FIN-4620.

billing-bot: CM-2026-042 created and applied to INV-2026-03-20; ticket FIN-4620 updated.

sam: I'll open an infra issue to normalize timezone handling and add a unit test to the weekend-promo matcher. Linking PR to FIN-4620.

marta: Add runbook steps for reconciliation (query to find other TZ edge cases) into FIN-4620 for auditors.

alex: Customer notified and acknowledged receipt of credit. They appreciate the quick fix.

kevin: Mark FIN-4620 resolved once PR and runbook attached. Good catch all.

marta: Marking FIN-4620 resolved; CM-2026-042 attached, invoice notes updated. Closing loop.

alex: Thanks team :pray:
